kicker: THE ONLY GYM PLAN YOU NEED
title: 5 exercises every man should *master*

label: 1. SQUAT
head: Squat
sub: Legs, core and posture. Start with bodyweight, 3 sets of 10, hips below the knees.

label: 2. DEADLIFT
head: Deadlift
sub: Teaches you to lift off the floor without hurting your back. Hinge at the hips, flat back.

label: 3. PUSH-UP
head: Push-up
sub: 3 sets close to failure. When 20 gets easy, wear a backpack full of books.

label: 4. PULL-UP
head: Pull-up
sub: Can't do one? Hang for 30 seconds, then lower yourself slowly for 5 seconds.

label: 5. FARMER CARRY
head: Farmer carry
sub: Grab the heaviest dumbbells you can hold and walk 40 meters. Grip, traps, core.

head: Your week
l: Chest day, arm day, skips legs
r: All 5 lifts, 3 days a week, 45 minutes

text: Add one rep or a little weight *every week.* That's the whole secret.
